method: Open-loop constant arrival rate: request i is due at t0 + i/rate and is issued then, regardless of outstanding requests (no coordinated omission). Latency = intended start to end of response; service latency = actual send to end of response. Each stage = a warm-up (excluded from the statistics) then the measured duration, at one rate. Mix (weights %): create_case 12, post_event 28, get_case_seeded 20, get_case_own 15, timeline 10, notifications 14, worklist 1. Cases for post_event/get_case_own/notifications are created by the run itself; get_case_seeded/timeline read cases from the seeded population (random sample of the `closure` table). Every non-2xx response is an error. The generator, the kind cluster (3 nodes in the Docker Desktop VM) and Postgres share one host: the generator's CPU use competes with the cluster. Per-pod CPU/memory come from the pods' cgroup files read with `kubectl exec` (no metrics-server), node CPU/memory from `docker stats`; per-pod request counts from the API pods' access logs; scheduler cadence of each scheduler task from the scheduler's own `tick` log lines (M7-8: the sweep, the two scans and the agency are separate timed tasks, ADR-047). A request the pod refuses with 503 + Retry-After + X-Shed (ADR-048) is counted apart from errors and from the latency of answered requests, and is never retried by the generator.
note_same_host: the load generator runs on the same host as the cluster
pass_criteria: p99 < 500 ms (answered requests, from intended start) and error rate < 0.1%; requests refused with 503 + Retry-After (load shedding) are counted apart and are not errors

stages.criteria: p99 (answered requests, from intended start) < 500 ms and error rate (not counting refusals) < 0.1%; refusals (503 + Retry-After) are reported apart; without_shedding additionally needs zero refusals

scheduler_during_stage.note: sweep_duration = time between the outbox-drain and sweep access-log lines (the sweep runs between them); period = gap between consecutive sweep completions (interval + all loop work)
